_comment: Divider test at 0.6 m, after the 0.6 m sweep: a thin black strip stands between the sensor windows, kept out of both fields of view. Two angles only (2 and 5 degrees per side, this mount only does whole degrees), both zones, five repeats, the same design as the 0.3 m and 0.8 m divider tests. Run with --tag divider. Run: python -m rig session --guided --port COM7 --config configs/rq3_jessica_0p6_divider.json --out data --tag divider
name: rq3-jessica-0p6-divider
